scenes.headline: Stop Inventing 30 Separate Ideas a Month
scenes.stat_label: ONE RESEARCH CORE = FIVE COMPOUNDING ASSETS
bullets: Amateurs chase daily trends and burn out fast
Solo media pros research 1 deep thesis every 7 days
scenes.narration: Amateurs burn out trying to invent thirty brand-new ideas every month. Smart one-person media businesses research one deep idea a week and slice it into five compounding assets.

scenes.headline: Treadmill Posting vs Upstream Architecture
scenes.left_body: Random daily posts -> shallow hooks -> vanishes in 24 hours
scenes.right_body: 1 Deep Script -> 1 Long Essay + 3 Vertical Shorts + 1 Newsletter
scenes.narration: Instead of waking up asking what to post today, build an upstream waterfall: write one thousand-word flagship script on Saturday morning as your master source code.

scenes.headline: 90 Minutes Upstream Feeds the Whole Week
scenes.stat_label: SATURDAY WRITING SESSION -> FULL WEEK OUTPUT
bullets: Asset 1: Evergreen YouTube visual essay for search
Assets 2-4: Three 50-second Shorts from top case studies
Asset 5: Weekly email newsletter issue you actually own
scenes.narration: That single script renders into one searchable long-form video, three punchy vertical Shorts extracted from its best stories, and one high-trust weekly email newsletter.

scenes.headline: Rent Discovery - Own the Email Relationship
scenes.stat_label: SHORTS ATTRACT -> LONG VIDEO BUILDS TRUST -> EMAIL OWNS
scenes.stat_subtext: Algorithm reach fluctuates; direct subscriber lists compound for years
scenes.narration: Short videos capture new eyeballs, long videos build deep authority, and your newsletter locks in audience equity that no sudden algorithm change can take away.

scenes.headline: 52 Weekly Ideas = 260 Assets a Year
bullets: Higher research quality because you only pick 1 topic/week
scenes.narration: Fifty-two weekly theses turn into two hundred sixty published assets a year without researching five separate topics. Which is the exact reason why...
